Callout.Name: Illegal Campfire
Callout.Message: Campfire reported in a fire-restricted area.
Callout.Advisory: Group of three around it, no weapons seen.

Script.Line: It is a fire ban. There are signs at every gate.
Three of them sat round it and they have been drinking.
They have seen me and they are not putting it out.

Lines.Approach: Three of them sat around a fire in a restricted area. They will not be pleased to see you.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
